rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for taking a physical object away from somewhere.

example.english: Please remove the cups from the table.
example.traditional: 請你攞走張枱上面啲杯。
example.jyutping: cing2 nei5 lo2 zau2 zoeng1 toi4 soeng6 min6 di1 bui1

rows.note: Use this for deleting digital files, messages, records, or other stored information.

example.english: Press the wrong button and you can remove this file.
example.traditional: 撳錯掣就可以刪除呢個檔案。
example.jyutping: gam6 co3 zai3 zau6 ho2 ji5 saan1 ceoi4 ni1 go3 dong2 on3

rows.note: Use this colloquial phrase for firing or dismissing someone from a job or post.

example.english: He’s always late, so the company may remove him from his job.
example.traditional: 佢成日遲到，間公司可能會炒佢魷魚。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 gaan1 gung1 si1 ho2 nang4 wui5 caau2 keoi5 jau4 jyu4

rows.note: Use this for letting go of or setting aside an abstract thought, feeling, or attachment.

example.english: I’ve finally managed to remove my resentment toward him.
example.traditional: 我終於放低咗對佢嘅怨恨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung1 jyu1 fong3 dai1 zo2 deoi3 keoi5 ge3 jyun3 han6
